src='''def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    todo = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 1]
    seen = set(todo)
    while todo:
        r, c = todo.pop()
        for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and g[nr][nc] == 0:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); todo.append((nr,nc))
    for r, c in seen:
        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''; open('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484937/attempts/902a26a1d741414098c8ca31bef93000/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ca06d76f.py','w').write(src)
